charms.name: Rime Edge
charms.summary: The axe keeps a tooth of ice and cuts deeper.

charms.name: Hoarfrost Wake
charms.summary: Cold air pools in your wake and drags on the avalanche.

charms.name: Sleet Ward
charms.summary: Rime crusts the coat and turns aside part of a blow.

charms.name: Cinder Flare
charms.summary: The flare sticks, and whatever it touches keeps burning.

charms.name: Ember Tithe
charms.summary: The mountain pays a little extra for every step you keep.

charms.name: Updraft Strap
charms.summary: Sailcloth across the chest. The wind does some of the climbing.

charms.name: Shearwind
charms.summary: The swing throws a second cut on the crosswind.

charms.name: Granite Hide
charms.summary: Grit packs the seams until the coat feels like a wall.

charms.name: Cairn Anchor
charms.summary: One stone set in the mind, and the avalanche loses its hurry.

charms.name: Talus Step
charms.summary: Loose rock underfoot, and less wasted motion.

charms.name: Lantern Wisp
charms.summary: A small light walks ahead and lengthens the axe's reach.

charms.name: Vigil Spark
charms.summary: At each cairn a spark settles back into the chest.

fusions.name: Glacial Pyre
fusions.summary: Frost locks the burn in the cut. The axe leaves a brand of white fire.

fusions.name: Stormbind
fusions.summary: The gale takes the wisp by the hand and carries it from foe to foe.

setBonuses.name: Rime Pair
setBonuses.summary: Two frost charms stiffen the edge.

setBonuses.name: Whiteout
setBonuses.summary: Four frost charms make the storm hesitate.

setBonuses.name: Kindled Pair
setBonuses.summary: Two ember charms bring more embers home.

setBonuses.name: Bonfire
setBonuses.summary: Four ember charms leave a deeper burn.

setBonuses.name: Paired Gust
setBonuses.summary: Two gale charms lift the stride.

setBonuses.name: Gale Crown
setBonuses.summary: Four gale charms throw one more cut.

setBonuses.name: Stacked Stone
setBonuses.summary: Two stone charms thicken the coat.

setBonuses.name: Bedrock
setBonuses.summary: Four stone charms shrug off a harder hit.

setBonuses.name: Twin Sparks
setBonuses.summary: Two spirit charms reach a little farther.

setBonuses.name: Vigil
setBonuses.summary: Four spirit charms kindle a stronger cairn rest.
